mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level (indicating a tighter monetary stance) increases the cost of capital, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 3.9% (from the prior month) signals an accelerating labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE rise >0.2pp), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (supply) and retail sales (demand) signals a broad-based economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve's tightening response compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (indicating weakening manufacturing activity) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1400.0 thousand units (indicating a contraction in the housing market) signals weak consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll growth rate below 0.5% (indicating slowing labor market expansion) signals reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
